args: In gpac/src/isomedia/box_code_base.c, what is the safest ownership-correct fix for audio_sample_entry_box_read around line 4289 when ptr->esd may either be a direct member of ptr->child_boxes or merely alias an ESDS owned by a nested QuickTime wave child? Please consider whether simply checking gf_list_find(ptr->child_boxes, ptr->esd) before gf_isom_box_del_parent and then nulling ptr->esd preserves cleanup and recovery semantics.

The sanitizer reports a UAF after malformed MP4A parsing. audio_sample_entry_on_child_box at lines 4180-4203 scans a wave child and assigns ptr->esd to an inner ESDS without moving it unless QT conversion is active. On child-array parse failure, audio_sample_entry_box_read at line 4289 unconditionally calls gf_isom_box_del_parent on the MP4A child list; that helper always frees the object even if list removal did not find it. The wave list consequently retains a freed pointer. Recovery then parses another ESDS and may append it directly. I am considering guarding deletion by direct-list membership, leaving a nested ESDS to its wave owner, setting the alias null, and parsing the recovered ESDS.
